plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control skin: limma-trend DE on TPM
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a gene-level TPM table from Salmon (12,000 genes x 12 samples; /data/inputs/abundance/tpm.csv) with a 12x2 metadata table giving condition for 6 lesional and 6 control human skin samples, unpaired, single batch. No raw counts and no Salmon quantification directories were delivered, which is the decisive constraint: DESeq2, edgeR and voom all assume integer counts with a negative-binomial mean-variance relationship, and TPM values break that assumption. The plan therefore uses limma on log2(TPM+1) with trend=TRUE and robust=TRUE — the sanctioned route for abundance-scale input — and states explicitly that the length/depth correction already embedded in TPM cannot be replaced by a count offset. Step T1S1 establishes sample structure on the log matrix (PCA/MDS on the 500 most variable genes, sample-distance heatmap, detected-gene counts per sample) so any outlier or unexpected grouping is named before the model, not after. Step T1S2 filters to genes at >=1 TPM in at least 6 samples (the smallest group size), fits ~condition with control as the explicit reference so a positive logFC means higher in lesional, applies eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE), and takes BH-adjusted p-values from topTable at FDR 0.05; when a fold-change floor is wanted it is tested inside the model with treat(), never as a post-hoc filter on the estimate. Step T1S3 is a small orientation step: psoriasis lesional skin has a well-known, very large transcriptional signature (keratinocyte hyperproliferation, IL-17/IL-23 axis, antimicrobial peptides), so the DE table is checked against that expectation and against the fact that only 12,000 genes were delivered — a pre-filtered subset of the transcriptome, which biases any gene-set interpretation and is reported as such. T1S4 writes the report with the full reproducibility record. No enrichment step is planned: the research question asks only which genes differ, and a 12,000-gene pre-filtered universe would make an enrichment universe hard to defend.

limma linear model on log-scale expression values (limma-trend)
